title: An invitation to dimension interpolation
summary: A \emph{fractal} is an object exhibiting complexity at arbitrarily small scales. In order to study and characterise fractals, one is often interested in quantifying how they fill up space on small scales. This gives rise to various notions of \emph{fractal dimension}. However, even for the simplest examples, the different definitions of dimension may completely disagree about the answer. In this expository article I will examine this phenomenon and use it to discuss and motivate \emph{dimension interpolation}.
